comment: Each side sums all the channels of its signal input and delays the sum, so the output is mono whatever goes in. The delay time is the knob times 0.4 seconds per volt at the time input; the code takes the absolute value, so -5V and +5V give the same delay. With nothing patched there the knob covers 0 to 2 seconds, which is what 5V gives with a cable in.
